# HEIC Local

> Convert HEIC photos to JPG or PNG in the browser. No upload, no signup, no watermark.

The public origin is https://heic-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Convert HEIC](https://heic-local.vercel.app) — Decode in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to convert](https://heic-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, JPG or PNG, ZIP.
* [Windows](https://heic-local.vercel.app/windows) — What Explorer will not open.
* [WhatsApp](https://heic-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — JPEG recode vs document.
* [iPhone](https://heic-local.vercel.app/iphone) — HEIC is the camera default.
* [What HEIC is](https://heic-local.vercel.app/info) — The container, not a lecture.
* [FAQ](https://heic-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.
* [Use cases](https://heic-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Portals that refuse HEIC.

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
